a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs at least 2 rounds of operating before anyone takes. That gives both of us only about a 4% chance of making it. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one unit right now. I won't pretend otherwise: I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. I'm telling you now so you can decide your own move with full information, not be surprised by it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks the agreement and I'm sorry it leaves you short. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can refill for your unit. I won't take anything more.
